name: Hooded Merganser
rangeDescription: Breeds northern north america; winters to mexico and west indies
description: Small diving duck with thin serrated bill. Breeding males have showy black-and-white crest, a couple zebra stripes on the white breast, and cinnamon-colored sides.

name: Brown-breasted Parakeet
rangeDescription: Eastern andes of colombia (boyacá and cundinamarca)
description: This medium-sized parakeet is restricted to the eastern Andes of central Colombia. Like other species in the genus, it is mostly green with a pointed tail.

name: Mississippi Kite
rangeDescription: Southern usa (arizona to florida); winters in south america
description: Long-winged raptor with narrow, pointed wings that help it maneuver to catch insects in flight. Gray overall with whitish head, white secondaries on upperside of wing, and black tail.

name: Guianan Trogon
rangeDescription: Venezuela, trinidad, the guianas, and adjacent northern brazil
description: Medium-sized, long-tailed, sluggish bird that occurs in a variety of humid forest types. Males are iridescent blue with a yellow belly; females are mostly grayish where males are blue.

name: Dubois's Seedeater
rangeDescription: Eastern brazil (southern minas gerais, espírito santo, and rio de janeiro)
description: Very small finchlike bird found in grasslands with bushes. Males are black above and white below with a black throat.

name: Bioko Speirops
rangeDescription: Bioko island (pico basilé)
description: In the field, appears overall chocolate-brown with a slightly long blue-gray bill and blue-gray legs. Plumage is paler on the flanks and vent and darker near the face.

name: Northern Wattled-Honeyeater
rangeDescription: Fiji (vanua levu and taveuni)
description: A medium-sized grayish honeyeater with an olive cast to the wings and a bright yellow-orange wattle on the cheek below the eye. Found mainly in mature forest.

name: Kirk's White-eye
rangeDescription: Grand comoro island
description: A small, sharp-billed warbler-like bird. Note the completely yellow underparts and the broad white spectacles around the eye.

name: White-cheeked Starling
rangeDescription: Northeastern asia; winters in southern china and philippines
description: This rather grimy-looking species is a familiar presence in many open habitats. Dark gray-brown overall with white cheeks of varying size, usually streaked with dark gray; white sometimes covers most of the head.

name: Highland Guan
rangeDescription: Humid montane forest from southern mexico to northern nicaragua
description: Large, long-tailed game bird of humid evergreen forest in highlands and foothills. Mostly seen high in trees, as singles or pairs, where they can move quickly and slip away easily from view.

name: Great Swallow-tailed Swift
rangeDescription: Mountains of southern mexico to southern honduras and (rarely) northern costa rica
description: Large, spectacular swift, seen singly or in small groups (up to 10 birds). Favors drier mountain and foothill areas, often near cliffs, but ranges widely.

name: Perija Brushfinch
rangeDescription: East slope of andes of eastern colombia and western venezuela (zulia)
description: Handsome brushfinch found only in the Perijá Mountains along the Colombia-Venezuela border, well north of the main chain of the Andes. It’s black mask and breast band, white throat, striped head, and olive back make it easy to identify within its very limited range.

name: Plum-headed Parakeet
rangeDescription: Indian subcontinent and sri lanka
description: A brilliantly-colored parakeet; males have a plum-colored head while females have grayish-blue head. Endemic to the Indian subcontinent where it can occur in any well-wooded area outside NE India and the high Himalayas.

name: Kai Besar White-eye
rangeDescription: Kai besar (kai islands)
description: A small green songbird with a bold white eye-ring and a primarily white underside, except for a yellow throat and base to undertail. Usually found in pairs or singly, roaming through forest, woods, and gardens in lowlands and lower hills.

name: Madagascar Plover
rangeDescription: Coastal southwestern madagascar
description: Small plover with a brown back, pale underparts, and a black chest band. Distinctive head pattern, with one black stripe behind the eye and another across the forehead.

name: Colombian Chachalaca
rangeDescription: Northern and central colombia
description: Large chickenlike bird. Restricted to central Colombia; the only chachalaca in its limited range.

name: Japanese Quail
rangeDescription: Eastern palearctic; winters to southeastern asia and eastern china
description: A compact, cryptically-colored, very shy bird of grassy areas, including both natural meadows and some agricultural fields, where it remains hidden from view on the ground unless flushed at close range. Both sexes brown overall with a pale face, long white eyebrows, and subtle stippling and striping on the back and breast.

name: Rufescent Antshrike
rangeDescription: Eastern peru south of the rio marañón (amazonas) to western bolivia
description: Scarce arboreal antbird found in cloud forest along the east slope of the Andes. Its brown and buff plumage, facial pattern, and behavior make it much more likely to be confused with a foliage-gleaner than with other antbirds, but note the stout bill with a hooked tip.

name: Taiwan Yellow Tit
rangeDescription: Montane forest of taiwan
description: Unmistakable songbird, black above and yellow below with white trim to the back of the triangular crest. Inhabits mountainous forests (up to 2800 m).

name: Seychelles Fody
rangeDescription: Seychelles islands (cousin, cousine, and frégate)
description: An unusual drab, long-billed fody. Breeding males have yellow patches on the face.
